analysis.executive_summary: Audit covered 2,260 pages across 2 documentation sites (docs.linearb.io and help.linearb.io) with 100% crawl coverage. Critical issues include 31 confirmed broken internal links within user-facing documentation and 0% API reference coverage despite 209 API pages detected. An additional 240 links could not be verified due to authentication or rate-limiting. Overall audit confidence stands at 53%, with link verification confidence critically low at 25%. Documentation split across multiple domains presents discoverability and consistency risks.
strengths: Complete crawl coverage achieved (100% of 2,530 discovered pages within scope)
No repository navigation broken links detected (repo_broken_links_count: 0)
Last-updated metadata present on 70.71% of pages
Large documentation footprint (2,260 pages) indicates comprehensive content
risks: 31 confirmed broken internal links in user-facing documentation degrade user experience and trust
240 unverified links (auth/rate-limit blocked) represent unknown link health and potential hidden breakage
0% API reference coverage with 209 API pages detected indicates complete absence of usage documentation or examples
SEO/geo issue rate of 7.6% may impact discoverability and search rankings
Documentation fragmented across 2 separate domains (docs.linearb.io and help.linearb.io) creates navigation confusion
Overall audit confidence of 53% and link confidence of 25% limit reliability of findings
29.29% of pages lack last-updated metadata, obscuring content freshness

prioritized_actions.action: Fix all 31 confirmed broken internal links in user-facing documentation
Add usage examples, code samples, and integration guides to 209 detected API pages to achieve minimum 60% reference coverage
Investigate and resolve 240 unverified links blocked by authentication or rate-limiting to determine actual link health
Consolidate documentation from 2 domains into single unified site or establish clear cross-linking and navigation between docs.linearb.io and help.linearb.io
Add last-updated metadata to remaining 29.29% of pages and address SEO/geo issues affecting 7.6% of content

limitations: External audit cannot verify 240 links blocked by authentication, rate-limiting, or server restrictions; actual broken link count may be higher
25% link verification confidence indicates significant uncertainty in link health assessment; manual validation recommended
API coverage detection relies on pattern matching; actual API documentation quality and completeness require manual review
Audit cannot assess content accuracy, technical correctness, or alignment with current product functionality
53% overall confidence score reflects detection limitations; findings should be validated through internal tooling and manual inspection
